# ADR 0002: Contract first: the API description is written and reviewed before the code

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Payment gateway integration hub

## Context

Several clients integrate with this service, and changing an API after they depend on it is expensive.

## Decision

Write the OpenAPI (or GraphQL schema / proto) contract first, review it in a pull request, then implement. The running service publishes its contract, and a test compares the published contract with the reviewed one.

## Consequences

Clients can start in parallel against a mock; breaking changes are caught in review. The contract and code must be kept in step (the test enforces it).

## Alternatives considered

Code first with generated docs only (the API's shape becomes an accident of the implementation).
